title: metric-deployment-operator-for-private-installs
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Adds a Kubernetes operator (MetricsOnboard) and supporting Helm/Terraform wiring to fully automate tenant-scoped PrometheusRule, recording rule, datasource and dashboard provisioning for Private installs. No API changes to existing install manifests; enables safer one-click monitoring onboarding for new tenants.
description:
Motivation: Private installs require repetitive, error-prone steps to create tenant-scoped PrometheusRules, Grafana datasources and dashboard folders. Manual steps cause drift and slow onboarding for on-prem customers. This PR introduces a small, focused Kubernetes operator and accompanying Helm+Terraform wiring that automates safe metric onboarding across VPC/on-prem deployments.

What this PR does: Adds a new CRD 'MetricsOnboard' managed by a controller (Go) that: - validates tenant metadata and available scrapers - generates PrometheusServiceMonitors and PrometheusRule resources using templates tuned for Redwood runtime metrics - creates Grafana datasource entries and tenant-specific dashboard folders via Grafana HTTP API with retry/backoff - optionally provisions scrape credentials from Vault (KMS/HSM integration) when external exporters require auth - records an immutable annotation with a rollout token so the operator can perform safe rollbacks. Also: - Helm chart updates for the monitoring subchart (prometheus-operator values) to accept operator-managed resources - Terraform module changes to expose the Grafana admin endpoint and RBAC role bindings required for the operator during Private installs - migration script to convert existing manual dashboards to operator-managed versions (idempotent).

Design notes: The operator is conservative by default: it only manages resources labeled with 'redwood.io/managed-by=metrics-onboard'. It supports a dry-run mode and has a reconciliation window (configurable) to avoid rapid churn. To avoid secrets leakage we use Vault templating and do not persist raw credentials in CRs; only references/annotations are stored. Rollback safety: the operator records resourceVersion snapshots and will restore previous manifests on operator-initiated rollback or on uninstall if --reconcile-rollback=true.

Files changed (high-level): added controller binary and CRD defs, updated monitoring Helm chart, Terraform module 'monitoring' inputs, migration CLI, unit/e2e test fixtures.

Rollout plan: 1) merge to release/1.23 behind feature flag --enable-metrics-onboard 2) enable for small set of internal Private installs (canary tenants) 3) monitor Prometheus scrape counts, grafana provisioning logs and error rates for 48h 4) progressively roll out to all new private installs.

Backward compatibility: Operator is opt-in and defaults to disabled. Existing installs are unaffected until the operator is enabled and the migration script is executed.

Notes & links: Linear ENG-8123 contains acceptance criteria and canary checklist. SUP-2331 references customer asks for simplified onboarding. Related infra PRs: terraform/monitoring updates in this branch.

review_comments: Liam Rivera: Nice approach, Priya. Two asks: 1) add a configurable rate limiter on Grafana API calls; 2) document the vault permission model. Could you also add a small e2e that runs the migration script in dry-run?
Priya Menon: Thanks Liam — added helm value 'grafana.rateLimit' and documented required Vault policies in docs/operator-vault.md. Added e2e dry-run scenario (see tests/e2e/monitoring/smoke_test.go).

Marco Li: Can we avoid creating ClusterRoleBindings by default? Some customers run strict RBAC. Suggest operator can use namespace-scoped role with ServiceAccount and optional ClusterRole when explicitly allowed.
Priya Menon: Implemented namespace-scoped mode and an explicit 'clusterScope: true' flag. Defaults to namespace-scoped to keep installs minimal.
Anika Shah: CI showed a flaky test earlier (Prometheus rule timing). Retried pipeline and green. Please ensure we add a note to the upgrade docs about prometheus-operator version pinning.
Priya Menon: Added a note in charts/monitoring/README.md and pinned prometheus-operator minor version in Chart.yaml.
merge_details: Merged by Anika Shah on 2026-03-05 using squash-merge. Auto-generated changelog entry created. Feature gated by --enable-metrics-onboard.
notes_about_rollout: Feature flag + canary tenants required. Migration script must be run with --dry-run first, then with --apply once operator logs are green. Grafana admin endpoint and vault access must be provided in terraform outputs prior to enabling operator.
tests_and_validation: Unit tests cover CRD validation and template rendering. E2E smoke validates: serviceMonitor creation, Prometheus rule firing (synthetic), Grafana datasource creation, and migration dry-run idempotency. Load test: operator handled 200 tenant onboardings in a loop in CI with 5s reconcile interval.
